input: File all loose receipts before the end of quarter

gold.taskTitle: File All Loose Receipts Before Quarter End
gold.taskDescription: Organize and file all loose receipts before the end of the current financial quarter.

questions.title: Where are the loose receipts physically located right now?
questions.description: Understand the current location of the receipts (desk drawer, wallet, bag, car, multiple spots, etc.).

questions.title: Roughly how many receipts are we talking about?
questions.description: Get a sense of the volume — a handful, dozens, or hundreds — to gauge effort required.

questions.title: Are these personal, business, or both types of receipts?
questions.description: Determine the nature of the receipts to understand the filing system and categories needed.

questions.title: What is the exact end-of-quarter deadline date for you?
questions.description: Confirm the specific deadline — fiscal quarter end can vary by company or country.

questions.title: Do you already have a filing system to put them into?
questions.description: Find out if a system (physical folders, spreadsheet, expense app) already exists or needs to be created.

questions.title: Are any receipts digital, or are they all paper?
questions.description: Clarify whether some receipts are email confirmations, photos, or PDFs that also need to be handled.

questions.title: Will someone else review or approve these filed receipts?
questions.description: Determine if the filing needs to meet a specific format for a manager, accountant, or tax professional.
